displayName: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation Invoking Script Engine

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/create", "-create")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell", "pwsh", "wscript", "cscript", "mshta", "cmd.exe", "\\temp\\", "\\public\\", "\\appdata\\")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation Invoking Script Engine
alertTemplate.description: Detects schtasks.exe creating scheduled tasks that invoke scripting interpreters or binaries located in user-writable temporary directories for persistence. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Inspect the scheduled task XML definition, validate the script target and owner account, and remove unauthorised persistence tasks (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-0843, ISM-1405, ISM-1621; Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques).
